objective: Rein diagnostische, zeitlich disjunkte Replikation der vollständigen Q015-Mechanismusdiagnostik. Die sechs bereits fixierten Q011-GDELT-Features, drei Mechanismusgruppen, Asset-/Horizontzellen, Transformation und Shapley-Regeln werden unverändert übernommen. Die Replikation erzeugt keine Handelsregel und keine Performancefreigabe.

point_in_time_contract.market_price_source: Yahoo Finance adjusted daily close, fetched once for the exact fixed window and frozen into the Q016 input artifact

diagnostic_method.sample: event-only observations with complete target return per fixed asset/horizon cell
diagnostic_method.group_decomposition: exact three-group Shapley decomposition of R-squared across all 6 fixed permutations

interpretation_guardrails: Q016 reproduces the fixed Q015 mechanism groups and rules without modification.
No feature, asset, horizon, parameter, subset order, threshold, or date block may be selected after observation.
The two one-year historical windows must remain strictly disjoint.
Insufficient historical data is reported as DATA_INSUFFICIENT rather than repaired opportunistically.
Q016 does not authorize a trading rule, performance trial, holdout evaluation, gate change, production use, or promotion.
Any subsequent performance hypothesis requires a separate preregistration, fresh symbol-disjoint coverage, unchanged evidence gates, and a fixed rule declared before evaluation.
